extensions.commands.keyboard-shortcuts.label: Keyboard shortcuts
extensions.commands.keyboard-shortcuts.help: Only the keys you change are saved.

extensions.commands.shortcut-hints.label: Show shortcut hints
extensions.commands.shortcut-hints.help: Keys appear next to buttons, and the cheat sheet is offered.

extensions.commands.search-shortcuts.label: Search shortcuts
extensions.commands.search-shortcuts.help: Filters the shortcut list as you type.

extensions.commands.text-editing-keys.label: Keys in the message box
extensions.commands.text-editing-keys.help: For moving and deleting while you type.

code.terminal.shortcuts.label: Keys in the terminal
code.terminal.shortcuts.help: Only while the terminal has focus.

extensions.commands.variant-cycling-key.label: Switch model variant
extensions.commands.variant-cycling-key.help: Flips between a model's variants without opening the picker.

extensions.commands.reset-shortcuts.label: Reset shortcuts
extensions.commands.reset-shortcuts.help: All of them at once. To reset one, open it and choose Use the default.

extensions.commands.override-builtin.label: Let my commands take a built-in name
extensions.commands.override-builtin.help: Core commands like /web and /stop are never replaced.

extensions.commands.git-routing.label: Keep /git and /github built in
extensions.commands.git-routing.help: Off lets your own command with that name run.

command-confirm.label: Ask again before a high-impact command
command-confirm.help: A second step before commands that change or delete a lot.
